issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other, Water/Sewer Fund column 103,079.75
issues.issue: The line was assumed to be water/sewer user charges. If so, the user's category is Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees.

Under the user's capital outlay rule the label should be 'Capital Outlay: <function>' with the printed text in printed_label. The '(Street Fund column)' suffix is not printed. disbursements[5] has the same problem.

The review note says the line was 'recorded as principal' (0% Highway Allocation note), but the category is the combined one and there is no debt_service_part. The user rule calls for category Debt Service with debt_service_part.
